{{Quote|Do good death!|Axeman verbalizes his less-than-intelligent bloodlust|<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Axeman''' was a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]]-wielding [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] who rode with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Gizz's Gang|swoop gang]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].

On one occasion, Axeman and the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] tried to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In the [[Beggar's Canyon Incident]], Skywalker knocked Axeman from his swoop and smashed the [[Swooper/Legends|swooper's]] ax with his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
==Personality and traits==
Axeman was one of the intimidating [[swooper/Legends|swoppers]] under Gizz. He was always armed with a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] to which he owed his nickname. Because of his minimal brightness, his peers associated the nickname with what happened to his brain.<ref name="sotesb" />
